description: This file defines a Flutter widget named AdaptiveRecommendations which displays a list of recommended items with associated tags, including UI components such as styled text, icons, and layout containers. It also defines a private widget _RecommendationTile for individual recommendation display.

classes.name: AdaptiveRecommendations
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that renders a list of recommended items with tags, including a header and a list of recommendation tiles.

classes.name: _RecommendationTile
classes.description: A private StatelessWidget that visually presents an individual recommendation with title and tags, styled and formatted with Flutter widgets.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for AdaptiveRecommendations, including header text and list of recommendation tiles.

methods.name: _RecommendationTile.build
methods.description: Constructs the visual layout for a single recommendation item, including icon, title, tags, and styling.
